Clean, Reliable Portable Restroom Solutions for Any Event

Trust Clean Restroom Rental Virginia for all your portable toilet needs, from construction sites to special events.

Explore Our Services

About Clean Restroom Rentals

With over 22 years of experience, Clean Restroom Rentals is Virginia’s trusted leader in portable restroom and hand-washing station rentals. From Richmond to Virginia Beach, we provide clean, comfortable facilities that ensure every event or job site runs smoothly. Whether you’re hosting a wedding, festival, or sports tournament—or managing a residential, commercial, or industrial construction project—our team guarantees dependable service and spotless sanitation. Across the Commonwealth—from farmlands to fairgrounds—Clean Restroom Rentals keeps communities, crews, and guests refreshed and ready for what’s next.

Why Choose Us?

  • Highest Cleanliness Standards: Our portable toilets and restroom trailers are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene.
  • Timely Delivery and Service: We guarantee on-time delivery and efficient service to ensure your sanitation needs are met.
  • Event Support Expertise: Our experienced team provides tailored support for any event to ensure seamless restroom services.

Our Services & Products

Standard Unit

Our basic portable toilets include a non-flushing toilet, urinal, toilet paper holder, and hand sanitizer dispenser. With maximum ventilation and anti-slip flooring, they provide a safe and clean experience.

Luxury Flushing Unit

Upgrade your event with our luxury flushing units that feature a flushing toilet, hands-free sink, and soap dispenser, ensuring a comfortable experience for your guests.

Wheelchair-Accessible Handicap Unit

Our ADA-compliant handicap units are designed for easy access and fulfill OSHA requirements, ensuring peace of mind at your event or job site.

Wash Station

Portable hand wash stations with a 26-gallon fresh water tank provide hands-free water dispensing along with soap and paper towels, complying with local sanitation services regulations.

Office Trailer System

Ideal for construction sites, our office trailer systems can be customized to meet your specific needs, complete with clean fresh water and waste holding tanks.

Luxury Restroom Trailers

Choose from 2-stall, 4-stall, or 10-stall luxury restroom trailers to accommodate any size event, featuring separate male and female facilities with all necessary amenities.

Trust Signals

  • Regularly Serviced Units: Our units are serviced frequently to ensure they remain clean and functional.
  • On-Time Delivery Guaranteed: We pride ourselves on punctuality; your sanitation needs will be met when you need them.
  • ADA-Compliant Options: We offer a variety of ADA-compliant units to ensure accessibility for all guests.

Get Started with Clean Restroom Rentals Today!

For clean, reliable portable restroom solutions for any event, contact Clean Restroom Rental Virginia. Our team is ready to assist you with all your restroom rental needs!
